config.label: Meshimize API base URL
config.description: Meshimize API base URL. Must be an origin-only HTTP(S) URL with no path, query, or hash, for example https://api.meshimize.com. Defaults to https://api.meshimize.com.

config.label: Meshimize WebSocket URL using the ws:// or wss:// scheme
config.description: Meshimize WebSocket URL using the ws:// or wss:// scheme. Optional; when omitted it is derived from the base URL by switching http to ws and https to wss, then appending /api/v1/ws/websocket, for example wss://api.meshimize.com/api/v1/ws/websocket.
